terra.problem: The peace oath took place at Beersheba, not Gerar (Genesis 26:23–26). Also, the visitors left in peace; Isaac did not leave with them.

The quarrel over the wells happened in the Valley of Gerar, not necessarily in the city (Genesis 26:17–22). The summary also skips a second disputed well, making it sound as though the next well after Esek was peaceful.
